# ---- 内存 | Memory ----
# NPDM 不声明系统资源：先用旷野之息（同样是 SDK 20）的分区（块 4 GB = 前置 256 MB + 别名区 256 MB + 栈区 256 MB + 堆区 3.25 GB），实测后再定

# The NPDM declares no system resource: starts from Breath of the Wild's partition (also SDK 20): 4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region, to be measured
mem_reserve
mem_alias
mem_stack
app_pool
# 引擎按「总内存 − 已用」向内核要堆（QueryMemoryInfo → SetMemoryHeapSize），主模块 106 MB 远超宿主默认的 64 MB 估值，
# 报出来的可用内存会多 41 MB 而被 SetHeapSize 拦下（起机即中止）。本作按模块真实体积报已用内存（见 docs/agents/03 的 Metroid Dread 同款）

# The engine sizes its heap as (total - used) (QueryMemoryInfo → SetMemoryHeapSize): with the host's 64 MB stand-in and 106 MB of modules the reported free memory is 41 MB too much and SetHeapSize stops boot.
# This title reports used memory as the modules' real footprint (see the Metroid Dread entry in docs/agents/03)
mem_used_image
# 静态预排布贴图的源页回收（nvn_mtl.m）：已上传为 GPU 私有副本后，把 guest 内存池里已死的源页还给系统（MAP_FIXED 换零页 + 移出驻留集）。
# 质量无损；环境变量 DM_TEX_RECLAIM / DM_TEX_RECLAIM_DRYRUN 覆盖档案值（device 验证周期先跑 dryrun）。
# Reclaim the guest source pages of static packaged textures once a GPU-private copy exists (nvn_mtl.m): dead source pages are returned to
# the system (MAP_FIXED zero-fill + residency removal). Quality-neutral; env DM_TEX_RECLAIM / DM_TEX_RECLAIM_DRYRUN override the profile.
tex_reclaim
# D1：池 Finalize 时把池的整页换成新的匿名页（内容拷回），Metal 才能放掉死掉的零拷贝缓冲（nvn_mtl.m mtl_pool_del）。
# 每次「进存档 → 退出游戏」原本净增约 119 个死缓冲 / 174 MB 显存且永不回落。环境变量 DM_POOL_RENEW=0 关掉（出问题时先用它排除），
# =2 只给测量用（换页但不拷回，池会被清零）。只在堆里、且不和活池内存重叠的池才会换。
# D1: on pool Finalize the pool's interior pages are replaced with fresh anonymous pages (bytes copied back) so Metal can free the dead
# zero-copy buffer (nvn_mtl.m mtl_pool_del); each "enter save -> quit to menu" used to leave ~119 dead buffers / 174 MB for good.
# DM_POOL_RENEW=0 turns it off; =2 is measurement only (renew without copying, the pool is zeroed). Heap pages only, never a page a live pool covers.
pool_renew
# ---- UI 绘制签名（宿主把屏幕空间 UI 整体平移时用） | UI draw signature (the host shifts the whole screen-space UI with it) ----
# 留空 = 本作还没有认出 HUD 的绘制类，宿主退回旧的 "4 顶点/2 属性/20 字节" 判据（本作全是索引绘制，那个判据永远不成立，
# 也就是"不平移"）。曾经填过帧首 5 个通道的 b9c900eb，**已推翻**：无条件丢掉它（DM_NVN_SKIP_FS=b9c900eb）后
# HUD 一个像素都不变，静止的暂停面板也不变；当初"丢它 HUD 就消失"是 HUD 自动淡出造成的假阳性（对照组同一秒也消失）。
# 平移机制本身已验证可用（16:9 下逐像素无变化）。**按位置认绘制的那条路已经做出来了**（nvn_mtl.m 的
# ui_draw_ndc / ui_safe_dir，开关 DM_UI_SAFEAUTO），血条、左列技能图标、金币会跟着右移，但文字（血量数字、
# 资源计数、计时器）不动，个别图标还会错位——停在那里，原因与入口见 §4.6。这里留空即可：这两个键只服务
# 按着色器 key 的老判据，本作不适用。
# Empty = the HUD's draw class has not been identified for this game, and the host keeps the old "4 verts / 2 attrs / 20-byte"
# test (every draw here is indexed, so that test never fires: the UI is not shifted). The first five passes' b9c900eb was tried
# and **retracted**: dropping it unconditionally (DM_NVN_SKIP_FS=b9c900eb) leaves the HUD pixel-identical, and the static pause
# panel does not change either. Position-based identification was implemented instead (ui_draw_ndc / ui_safe_dir,
# DM_UI_SAFEAUTO): bars, the left skill column and the coin icon move, but text does not and some icons land off; see §4.6.
# These two keys only serve the old shader-key test and stay empty for this title.
ui_fs_key
ui_vs_key
